titles.landing: Full Stack Engineer · React · Next.js · Node.js · TypeScript

paragraphs.first: I build modern web applications focused on performance, usability, and scalable architecture. My main expertise is React, Next.js, and TypeScript, backed by solid experience across the full stack with Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and cloud services.
paragraphs.second: Over the past few years I've worked on SaaS products, public sector platforms, and geospatial applications, taking features from technical design through production. I enjoy turning complex requirements into intuitive user experiences while collaborating closely with product and engineering teams.
paragraphs.third: This portfolio showcases some of the projects I've worked on, the technologies behind them, and the way I approach software development. Feel free to explore my work or download my CV if you'd like to know more.
paragraphs.contact: Do you have a question or an idea in mind? I am here to help you! Feel free to contact me via email. I look forward to hearing your thoughts and collaborating on your next project.

projects-cards.title: Orchestrator Agents
projects-cards.content: Multi-agent orchestration system based on cyclic graphs with LangGraph. It breaks down complex business requests into subtasks run by specialist agents (web research, writing, review), pauses for human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval, and consolidates the result in vector memory. Includes a React chat UI with SSE streaming and LangGraph Studio for debugging. Stack: LangGraph, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Groq (Llama 3.3), Tavily, ChromaDB, Gemini embeddings.

projects-cards.title: Terra Scan — Geospatial Intelligence Platform
projects-cards.content: B2B SaaS platform for geospatial analytics and precision agricultural monitoring. The system centralizes plot and farm management through the integration and real-time processing of multispectral satellite analytics (NDVI from Planet and Sentinel) and the Google Earth Engine engine. It includes a critical module for early detection and historical tracking of fire hotspots based on NASA (FIRMS) data, optimized through specific geographic filters. It features secure authentication (Google OAuth), environment control, and efficient handling of large volumes of geographic data (PostGIS) under strict retention policies. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NestJS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Prisma, Google Cloud.

projects-cards.title: Educational logistics platform
projects-cards.content: Frontend development for the Ministry of Education (public sector): a logistics and inventory management platform built from scratch, replacing a legacy system and centralizing operations across the province. It includes role-based access control (JWT), dashboards, reporting tools, and Excel exports for day-to-day operations; it manages approximately 70% of provincial school resources. Stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, JWT, Railway.

projects-cards.title: Helping Crew

It allows service bookings with automatic price calculation, stored in Firebase, and sends confirmation emails to both the client and the company administrator. It also includes customized contact and quote request forms, optimized for client acquisition and direct communication.

experiences.title: Boty Cloud
experiences.description:
SaaS platform for high-volume Mercado Libre sellers — invoicing, price adjustments, and multi-account operations with AI. Remote.

* Designed and developed a BFF layer with over 20 endpoints in Next.js to integrate Cloud Run, BigQuery, Gemini, and Firebase services.

* Led the redesign of the main interface, improving accessibility and usability while reducing backend queries by 66% through state optimizations and data-fetching strategies.

* Diagnosed end-to-end incidents with full access to the NestJS backend and GCP, speeding up resolution by providing precise technical context to the backend team.

* Participated in the design of the multi-warehouse inventory system, translating business requirements into technical decisions to support multiple warehouses and platforms.

* Designed onboarding flows, guided tours, and in-app notifications, simplifying highly configurable features for non-technical users and reducing repetitive support tickets.

* Strengthened code quality by integrating Sentry and Jest regression tests; collaborated on deployment incident resolution by adjusting Dockerfiles for Google Cloud builds and migrated the UI kit to Shadcn UI.

Technologies and tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, Shadcn UI, Tailwind, TanStack Query, Sentry, GCP, Firebase, Cloud Run.

experiences.title: Ministry of Education
experiences.description:
Public sector — logistics and inventory management platform. Fixed-term contract, completed on time. Argentina.

* The system currently manages an estimated 70% of school resources across the province of Chubut (Patagonian region of Argentina), covering schools and logistics operations.

* Developed a web platform from scratch to centralize and optimize school furniture and supply management — stock movements, delivery tracking, and distribution to educational institutions — replacing a legacy system.

* Implemented role-based access control (JWT), entity management (schools, warehouses, carriers), and remittance tracking with state handling.

* Built dashboards, reporting tools, Excel exports, and minimum-stock alerts to support day-to-day operations.

* Integrated with existing systems, including Tango Gestión (SQL Server), managing data migration and adaptation processes.

Technologies and tools: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, JWT, Railway.

experiences.title: Terra Scan
experiences.description:
NestJS REST API and Next.js frontend for geospatial and satellite monitoring of rural plots in Argentina.

* Designed and developed the core backend of a geospatial monitoring platform, implementing a NestJS REST API with modular architecture, JWT authentication via JWKS, and strict DTO validation.

* Integrated Google Earth Engine, Sentinel Hub, and PostGIS to process satellite metrics (NDVI) and implement early fire detection with NASA (FIRMS) data.

* Implemented caching strategies to control costs and latency of external satellite APIs, and designed the system to degrade gracefully if Earth Engine is unavailable at startup.

* Managed secure PDF report storage and download via signed Supabase Storage URLs.

* Covered the backend with unit and end-to-end tests (Jest + Supertest).

Technologies and tools: NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Next.js, TypeScript, Google Earth Engine, Sentinel Hub, Supabase.
